definitions.explanation: A responsibility or function that someone is expected to fulfill.
The purpose or function that something serves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}された→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: I was entrusted with the role of host/MC.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}な→重要：01575_juuyou⟧{役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: This part plays an important function.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしたい→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to fulfill my duty as a parent.
This wall also serves the function of soundproofing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}する→保存する：03626_hozon⟧{役目|やくめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Salt has the function of preserving food.

notes:
{役目|やくめ} refers to duties, roles, or functions assigned to someone or something.

Common collocations:
- {役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to fulfill one's duty/role)
- {役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧ (to complete one's role)
- {役目|やくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}される→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ (to be entrusted with a role)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役目|やくめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have the function of ~)

Related terms:
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧ (role - similar but more commonly used for roles in society/relationships)
- ⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧ (duty, mission - more formal)
- ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧ (official duties)
- ⟦{務|つと}め→務め：03438_tsutome⟧ (duty, service)

Contrast:
- {役目|やくめ} emphasizes the specific task or function
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧ emphasizes the position or part one plays
